brief:
Nearly consensus has formed that the period preceding Israel's scheduled October 27 elections constitutes a phase of political stasis, according to Shehab Wire. The country faces constraints on advancing major agreements or commitments before voters head to the polls.

Political paralysis ahead of elections is common in many democracies, though Israeli officials view the timing as particularly restrictive given current regional circumstances.

title: Israeli political gridlock deepens ahead of October election
